text: Yet it drifts only a few seconds a day.
Open it up, and three systems share the work.
A wound spring stores the power.
A train of gears passes it on, faster at every step.
In this teaching movement, four thousand eight hundred times faster.
asr: In this teaching movement, 4,800 times faster.

text: Left alone, the spring would empty in a single rush.
So the escapement lets it out, half a tooth at a time.
The balance swings back and forth, five beats every second.
Spring, gears, balance. That is how it keeps time.
